data: Which of the lines never achieve a y-value lower than 0.5?

The question asks which line(s) never achieve a y-value lower than 0.5. From the analysis of the figure, the red line consistently stays above the yellow line throughout the graph. The red line appears to maintain a y-value higher than 0.5 across all x-values, while the yellow line dips below 0.5 at some points. Therefore, the red line is the one that never achieves a y-value lower than 0.5.
